theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_c1c_lipschitz_range_c1_pieces
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (F : Euclid m → Euclid P) (K : NNReal), LipschitzWith K F → (∀ (u : Euclid m → ℝ) (L : NNReal), LipschitzWith L u → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ g : Euclid m → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ volume {y | u y ≠ g y} < ε) → ∃ (E : Set (Euclid P)) (G : ℕ → Euclid m → Euclid P), μHE[m] E = 0 ∧ (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (G i)) ∧ Set.range F ⊆ E ∪ ⋃ i, Set.range (G i)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
